tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: What the book rests on: the ground outside the page on wide and spread layouts, the area behind sheets. Never under body text that is not also on a paper token.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page. Default background of every screen; body text in `ink` and `ink-soft` reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Clay: cards, buttons, sheets, the active dock bead. Always paired with the `clay` shadow so it reads as lifted, not just lighter.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, the pressed state of a clay object, unread page-edge, empty verdict pips.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate without meaning anything: list dividers, the gutter fold, decorative frames. Not a control boundary.

tokens.name: rule-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries that carry meaning (3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk in both themes): the input underline, the sheet grab handle, unchecked toggles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk`, `desk` and every `-wash` token, both themes. The only text colour allowed on glass (dock and rail labels, toast text and its action): at least 6.2:1 over any cover or art behind it.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: by-lines, metadata, inactive shelf-switch segments, the shelved and paused states. 4.5:1 on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk, desk and every entry wash in both themes. Not on glass: over a dark cover it drops to 4.3:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the set-aside state only. 4.5:1 on the three paper tokens, desk and every entry wash in both themes (darkened in Paper so it holds on desk), but it is the quietest legible text the system allows: never for anything Tyler needs to read twice, never on glass.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: The system's own accent: the primary action, the open (in progress) status, the ribbon bookmark, links. As text on paper, paper-raised and lamp-wash in both themes.

tokens.name: lamp-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a lamp button, and the hover of lamp text. Pair with `on-lamp`.

tokens.name: on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `lamp` or `lamp-deep` fill (the Log button glyph, primary button labels). Light in paper, dark in lamplight: never hard-code white.

tokens.name: lamp-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind lamp text: the active filter chip in lamp, the 'Noted' toast underlay, the default entry endpaper.

tokens.name: quill
tokens.usage: Blue-black fountain-pen ink. The finished status and its wax seal, the focus ring, and the input underline on focus. As text on paper, paper-raised and quill-wash.

tokens.name: quill-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind quill text: the 'Closed on …' pill, the seal's emboss highlight in lamplight.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The returning status (replay, reread, rewatch, on repeat). As text on paper, paper-raised and moss-wash.

tokens.name: moss-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind moss text.

tokens.name: scorch
tokens.usage: Destructive only: delete an entry, discard a note. As text on paper, paper-raised and scorch-wash; always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: scorch-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind scorch text: the delete confirmation sheet's header.

tokens.name: on-scorch
tokens.usage: Text on a `scorch` fill (the confirm-delete button).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on glass are `ink`, nothing quieter and no accent. Floating chrome only: the dock, the scrolled top bar, the toast. Always with `backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(1.2)` and the `glass-edge` shadow. Never under reading text, never glass on glass.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dim behind an open sheet.

tokens.name: silk
tokens.usage: The ribbon bookmark hanging from an open entry's cover. An object, so the same in both themes; its edge shadow, not contrast, separates it from cover art.

tokens.name: wax
tokens.usage: The wax seal pressed onto a finished entry's cover (quill's Paper value, fixed). Its impression ring is `gilt`.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Title lettering stamped on a generated cloth plate (an entry with no cover art). Plates are objects, so gilt does not change with the theme; it holds 4.5:1 on every cloth the ink binder can produce.

tokens.name: entry-ink
tokens.usage: Runtime: replaced per entry by `bindInk(coverColour)`; falls back to lamp. Drop caps, the hanging quote mark, filled verdict pips, the where-label of a note, the read part of the page edge. As text only on paper and paper-raised (the binder guarantees 4.5:1 there). On a wash, only icons and pips: entry ink on its own wash measures 4.28–4.49:1 for some cloths.

tokens.name: entry-wash
tokens.usage: Runtime: replaced per entry by `bindInk`; the endpaper behind an entry's cover at the top of its page, a bookmark card, a dream card. Text on it is `ink`, `ink-soft`, `ink-faint` or a state colour (all 4.5:1 on every wash); `entry-ink` on it is for icons and pips only.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Literata at display sizes: the same face as the reading text, set semibold, with optical sizing doing the work (the browser picks the opsz cut from the size). Upright only. Names of works and the big number.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: The entry's own title on its page (phone). Wide layouts step it to 56px/58px.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Part titles: Media, Prologue, Journal, Find.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: A work's title in rows, tiles, sheets and on plates.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Titles under covers on a shelf, two lines at most.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Passages Tyler keeps. Only for words someone else wrote.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one big number on the log sheet (the chapter, episode or hour being logged).

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Literata, built for reading on screens (it began as Google Play Books' face), shipped as a variable woff2 in fonts/ (OFL, opsz 7–72, full Vietnamese). Everything Tyler writes, and every field he writes it in. Upright only: quiet text is quieter in colour, never slanted.

styles.name: read
styles.sample: Đoạn này nghe lúc 2 giờ sáng, đúng là hết nói.
styles.usage: Reviews and notes on an entry page; the note textarea. Measure capped at `measure`.

styles.name: read-sm
styles.sample: Stayed by the fire instead of sleeping.
styles.usage: Note previews in lists and the journal stream.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: Half-formed notes, a dream's why, the verdict's sentence, empty states. Set in `ink-soft`: quiet by colour, not by slant.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Lexend, shipped as a variable woff2 in fonts/ (OFL; full Vietnamese): wide, open letterforms meant to reduce visual stress, so a line reads at a glance. Everything the app says, and every line meant to be read in passing.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, the shelf switch, section heads, row labels.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: By-lines, metadata, progress captions. Numbers in it use tabular figures.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Dock and rail labels under their glyphs, in `ink` (they sit on glass). Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Running heads above a section, set in capitals by the component. English UI words only: never uppercase a title or anything Tyler typed.

spacing.note: 4px base. Phones use space-4 gutters; nothing in the system is tighter than space-1.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to word inside a status or kind mark.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a title and its by-line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between covers on a shelf; between rows' contents; the dock's inset from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; card and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between notes in a margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; wide-layout card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a phone screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page padding on wide layouts.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Page padding on the spread; the gutter between its two pages.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Top of an entry page above the cover (the endpaper).

radius.note: The furniture is soft clay; the things you collected are crisp. Covers are nearly square-cornered because books are.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: Every cover and plate, every kind. Never rounder.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Verdict pips, tally boxes, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons at 44px and 52px, rows that press.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the shelf plank group.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The dock and sheet tops: concentric with an iPhone XS screen corner at a space-3 inset.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, round icon buttons, the grab handle, the seal.

shadow.note: Warm-tinted in paper (never grey), black in lamplight with a faint top highlight. Clay objects carry a 1px inner top light; that highlight is what makes them read as solid.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Clay at rest: buttons, cards, chips when active, the dock bead.

tokens.name: clay-lift
tokens.usage: Clay on hover (pointer only), while dragged, and for sheets.

tokens.name: clay-press
tokens.usage: Clay while pressed: it sinks 1px and the light goes inside.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: inputs, empty verdict pips, the page-edge track.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The rim and drop of a glass surface (with the `glass` colour).

tokens.name: cover
tokens.usage: Every cover and plate: a physical object resting on the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then 2px solid quill (at least 3:1 on every paper token and desk, both themes). Added to, never replacing, the object's own shadow.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layouts are built from.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target, anywhere. A visual can be smaller; its hit area cannot.

tokens.name: dock-height
tokens.usage: The glass dock on compact layouts: Media · + · Prologue (plus the bottom safe area).

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The clay navigation rail on medium, wide and spread layouts.

tokens.name: shelf-width
tokens.usage: The list column on wide and spread layouts.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: One page of the book: an entry on wide layouts, each half of the spread.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text, anywhere, at any width.

blur.note: Glass is one recipe, used sparingly.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for every glass surface (dock, scrolled top bar, toast). Native: SwiftUI Material, Haze on Compose; see the README's Native section.
